name: Ultimate Light Rail
summary: Light rail stations: surface, underground or elevated; five lengths and optional approach fences.
description: Ultimate Light Rail 0.13.0 adds Elevated as a third station location. Elevated tracks sit 8m above ground on a concrete deck with crossbeams and piers. One ground-level entrance centred along the station branches to two visible stair flights and both platforms. Native concrete bridge parts form 82 treads, two supporting stair waists and the viaduct; there is no raised terrain embankment. Platform and stair safety railings remain when optional approach fencing is disabled. Elevated is available as a through station or terminus in all five platform lengths (40/60/80/100/120m). Termini always have a crossover; through stations never do. Existing surface/underground stations and saved parameter values remain unchanged. The user confirmed all 0.12.0 lengths work; Elevated requires a new in-game placement and boarding test. Start on level ground, connect a street at the central ground entrance and electric tramtrack on bridges at +8m. Base station prices and capacity are unchanged for this prototype. Do not remove the mod while its infrastructure remains in a save.
